subject: AWS Marketplace offer — short teaser, entitlements, and co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Sarah Benitez <sarah.benitez@acmelogistics.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft AWS listing copy attached

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for walking us through the AWS listing checklist last week. Attached is our first-pass product description and bullets (file: 20261208-acme-listing-draft.docx). Can you and Marissa take a look at the short teaser and the usage examples? The AWS reviewers flagged the hero one-liner as too technical — we want something punchier that matches co-sell messaging.

Primary ask: short teaser (1 line), 3 bullets for benefits (non-technical), and one clear billing/CTA sentence for the marketplace product page.

Also: we expect to submit a Private Offer for initial pilots — will need guidance on SKUs and entitlements.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Partnerships
Acme Logistics

Attachment: 20261208-acme-listing-draft.docx (docx)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Benitez <sarah.benitez@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing copy attached

Sarah —

Got it, thanks for the draft. Quick initial pass below and attached a PDF with inline notes (20261210-acme-listing-annotated.pdf). High-level suggestions: 

- Teaser: make it outcome-first and customer-focused. I suggest: "Make on-time deliveries predictable with real-time routing optimization."
- Bullets (3): keep to customer outcomes + measurable impact. Examples I hacked in: 
  1) Reduce route deviation and idle time (avg. 12-18% fuel savings)
  2) Real-time re-routing to avoid delays and improve on-time delivery SLA
  3) Integrates with major TMS and preserves PII with tenant isolation
- Billing/CTA: "Buy with flexible pilot pricing or contact the sales team for a Private Offer." (short, action-oriented)

Marissa & Soojin — could you both look for any Marketplace copy rules we need to follow? Soojin, can you flag anything that would break the AMI/branding policies? Marissa, once we lock the teaser and bullets I can draft a co-sell one-pager and suggested talk track for AWS reps.

I also noted a couple of entitlement questions in the doc regarding feature gating across SKUs — Sarah, could you confirm whether the data-retention and audit-logs features are part of the baseline SKU or an add-on?

Thanks,
Dylan
Sr. Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261210-acme-listing-annotated.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft AWS listing copy attached

Forwarding Sarah's draft + Dylan's notes. I made a first-pass marketplace-friendly hero and condensed bullets into the AWS character limits (see attached co-sell playbook draft). Key decisions we need:

1) Final hero/teaser (short, 60 chars recommended)
2) SKU mapping: pilot SKU vs. production SKU parity
3) Call-outs for security/compliance to include in the short text (SOC2 / VPC connectivity)

I attached a co-sell playbook draft (20261214-co-sell-playbook-v1.md) with suggested AWS rep talking points, value metrics to push during discovery, and a private-offer checklist. Please review and add any legal/entitlement constraints.

Marissa
Partner Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261214-co-sell-playbook-v1.md (markdown)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft AWS listing copy attached

Thanks for the draft — short notes from a legal/ops perspective: 

- SKU & entitlements: keep data-retention and audit-logs as optional add-ons (separate SKU lines). That avoids licensing confusion for pilots and simplifies Private Offer pricing.
- Private Offer steps: need approved PoA (proof of acceptance) doc + listing SKU IDs. I'll own the SKU ID mapping — give me product feature matrix by Friday.
- Marketplace copy: avoid absolute claims ("guarantees 99% SLA") — use measured language ("helps achieve").
- Privacy/PCI: call out SOC2 in bullets but do not include customer names or specific metrics in public listing.

I'll append a formal SKU mapping table after I get the feature matrix.

—Karthik
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

Sarah / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and great input. Short summary / next steps so we can get the listing into AWS UAT next week: 

1) Teaser approved: final one-liner to use on the listing hero — "Make on-time deliveries predictable with real-time routing optimization." (Marissa to confirm <= 60 chars; she trimmed it to 58)
2) Bullets final (public listing-friendly):
   • Reduce route deviation and idle time, cutting fuel spend
   • Real-time re-routing to avoid delays and improve on-time delivery
   • Enterprise integrations + tenant isolation for data protection (SOC2 ready)
3) SKUs: Karthik will produce SKU mapping by EOD next Friday; data-retention and audit-logs will be add-on SKUs
4) Private Offer: we will draft pilot pricing + PoA template. Dylan to create HubSpot checklist and upload DocuSign link.

Action owners:
- Marissa: finalize hero (60 chars), deliver final copy + one-pager for AWS reps (due Mon 21 Dec)
- Karthik: SKU mapping & Private Offer checklist (due Fri 25 Dec)
- Dylan: HubSpot deal note + DocuSign pilot PO template; schedule AWS onboarding call once assets are uploaded

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/RDW-2026-AWS-0987) | Offer assets (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/marketplace/acme-offer-assets)

If there are no blockers I will submit the listing for preliminary review to aws-marketplace-onboarding@amazon.com on Monday.

Thanks all —
Dylan

Redwood Inference
